column1: # MLGD-F inference hyperparameters for the MNIST rotation experiments. Read by run.sh full.
# unimodal: paper Table 13. bimodal and uniform: chosen from the hyperparameter grid
# the paper's Table 13 had bimodal 1500/125/10/original/252 and uniform 600/290/3/original.
# Fixed across all three targets: SWD with 50 projections, 15 independent runs,
# iCT sampling steps [150, 50, 20, 10, 5, 1], NO per-step clamp (run.sh passes
# --no-clamp: the paper's run records hold pixel values up to 2.0-3.3, which a
# [-1, 1] clamp cannot produce; the source runner's --clamp is off by default).
# target    n_cond  T     n_mc  step_size_mode  variance
